reason_for_addendum: V2 correctly documents that F before 2023 is a different measurement regime, but its unstratified minimum-full-gain formula nevertheless forces a 2025 post-break F correction to improve the irrelevant pre-break 2022 F labels. V3 keeps the same actual-LB anchor, haircut, complexity limit, temporal lock, and 2024 CI requirement, while making the already documented F regime boundary explicit.

regimes.R: one continuous regime; transfer must pass 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023 before 2024
regimes.F_prebreak: season <= 2022; the candidate must preserve its exact-C parent
regimes.F_postbreak: season >= 2023; the fixed row-local recent-game update applies

development_gates.R_same_parent: point gain and pitcher-cluster 95% CI lower bound are positive in 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023
development_gates.F_source_mechanism: the fixed recent-game estimator has positive point and CI lower bound in source 2020 and 2021
development_gates.F_postbreak: point gain and CI lower bound are positive in 2023
development_gates.legacy_2022_guard: with F preserved, full point gain and CI lower bound versus exact C are positive
development_gates.postbreak_development_full: for 2023, point gain and CI lower bound versus exact C and both honest R anchors each exceed 132.11992465293324

confirmation_2024.same_parent_R_and_F: point gain and CI lower bound positive
confirmation_2024.all_anchor_full: point gain and CI lower bound versus exact C and both honest R anchors each exceed 132.11992465293324

conservative_expected_score.G_dev: minimum of 2023 full point and CI lower gains over exact C and both honest anchors
conservative_expected_score.G_confirm: minimum 2024 full point gain over exact C and both honest anchors
conservative_expected_score.G_ci: minimum 2024 full pitcher-cluster CI lower gain over exact C and both honest anchors
